improvements.rationale: A well-crafted meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating Gideon's value proposition. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, or messaging apps—critical for a B2B product targeting professionals. Including the free trial offer creates urgency and lowers perceived risk.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product by name and clearly defines what it does, reducing cognitive load for visitors. The subheading reinforces the three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while creating a low-friction call to action with the free trial offer. The copy is direct and benefit-focused without making unsubstantiated claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue accessing Gideon. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the free trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition, pricing options, and member benefits upfront, it reduces uncertainty, builds trust, and primes visitors to convert before they hit the paywall.
